name: Meraki
description: Meraki is a completed apartment development in Yadavagiri. Nine 3 BHK homes are laid out for generous shared space and daylight, with premium fittings throughout.

items: Premium vitrified tiles to living areas and bedrooms
Anti-skid tiles to bathrooms and balconies
Large windows for ventilation and light
